opportunities.title: Iran-Linked Hackers Are Quietly Draining US Water Utilities — NJ and Alabama Just Joined the List

opportunities.angle: Rolling incident tracker: map which states/utilities are hit, what OT protocol was abused, and what DEF CON's new defensive tooling actually does about it.

opportunities.title: The Metabase Zero-Day Nobody Patched in Time: Framework's Customer Data Is Now Someone Else's Problem
opportunities.why_now: A live zero-day in a widely-deployed BI tool just burned a hardware vendor's customer data, and the patch only landed after exploitation began.
opportunities.angle: Patch-cadence postmortem: timeline from zero-day discovery to Framework breach to official fix, with a 'check if you're exposed' checklist for Metabase admins.

opportunities.title: Hackers Shut Down a Polish Power Plant Turbine — Through a Cell Network Nobody Was Watching

opportunities.angle: Deep-dive explainer on private cellular network attack surface in critical infrastructure — the overlooked ICS entry point everyone assumed was air-gapped.

opportunities.title: Gunra Ransomware Is Chaining Fortinet and Schneider Electric Bugs — Your Patch Backlog Is the Attack Path
opportunities.why_now: US and South Korea just issued a joint advisory as Gunra actively exploits known Fortinet/Schneider flaws against government and critical infrastructure targets.
opportunities.angle: CVE-to-breach chain breakdown: list the specific Fortinet/Schneider CVEs being exploited, patch status, and why 'checklist' patching keeps failing (tie into Dark Reading's patch-chains piece).

opportunities.title: Your SIM Card Can Now Be Weaponized to Downgrade Your Phone to 2G and Wipe Your Files
opportunities.why_now: A fresh malicious-SIM technique lets attackers force devices back to insecure 2G and remotely brick or exfiltrate data — a novel, consumer-relevant threat vector just disclosed.
opportunities.angle: Explainer + threat-actor speculation piece: who'd use this (SIM-swap gangs? nation-states?) and what carriers/users can actually do to detect a malicious SIM before it strikes.
